metadata.description: Anki flashcard management skill for Claude Code — create decks, add cards, generate flashcards from any source, and track study progress via AnkiConnect

plugins.name: anki
plugins.description: Manage Anki flashcards via AnkiConnect HTTP API. Supports deck operations, batch card creation from text/PDF/CSV/Excel, custom note templates, study statistics, and built-in flashcard generation with spaced repetition best practices.
